front.title: AlphaGenome 2: deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
front.tldr: DeepMind has released a second version of AlphaGenome, which predicts how DNA sequences and variants affect specific human cell types. The aim is a better understanding of how such changes contribute to disease.

front.title: iFixit reveals the magic behind the new glowing MacBook Pro logo
front.tldr: iFixit's teardown of the new MacBook Pro shows how Apple brought back the glowing logo, a detail Six Colors had asked Apple about directly at a briefing.

front.title: Celtics win 5th straight, overcoming 22-point deficit to beat Raptors 98-93
front.tldr: Boston erased a 22-point deficit to beat the Raptors 98-93, their fifth straight win. Jayson Tatum scored 24, Derrick White added 19 and Payton Pritchard chipped in 14 off the bench.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
stories.tldr: Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API, built on a new Gemini Decision model for fast, calibrated multimodal choices. It follows OpenAI's similar Jev decision model into the same category.

stories.title: AWS ships an official emulator for testing against its services locally
stories.tldr: AWS has released an official open-source emulator, written in Rust, that lets developers run tests against a local clone of its services without needing a paid API key.

stories.title: Britain's Fractile raises $720m to build custom AI chips
stories.tldr: UK startup Fractile has raised $720 million in new funding, making it one of the best-funded companies racing to build purpose-built AI chips.

stories.title: Google Labs launches Tabletop, a collaborative planning space for groups
stories.tldr: Google Labs has opened a waitlist for Tabletop, an experiment for building interactive itineraries, polls and brackets together as a group, aimed at shared planning rather than solo chat.

stories.title: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights
stories.tldr: United Airlines is blocking AI agents from booking its flights, citing security risks and possible breaches of DOT and FAA rules.

stories.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10 billion for the first time
stories.tldr: OpenAI's quarterly revenue has reportedly passed $10 billion for the first time, up almost 50% from the $6.7 billion it recorded in the second quarter.

stories.title: Roku will stop selling smart home devices and refocus on streaming
stories.tldr: Roku is exiting smart home hardware, including its video doorbells and home monitoring system, to concentrate on its streaming business.

stories.title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID technology
stories.tldr: Siri's co-founder is backing Helix, a startup betting that voice-based biometric signals will become how we verify identity as AI agents take on more tasks online.

stories.title: iPhone Duo one week later: the future, or not for me?
stories.tldr: A week in with the folding iPhone Duo, 9to5Mac's review is mixed: impressive as a daily carry, but still unsure whether it is the iPhone's future or just not for this reviewer.

stories.title: Live Rewind makes me want to buy an Apple Watch
stories.tldr: Six Colors' Dan Moren, who has never owned an Apple Watch, says the new Live Rewind feature is the first thing that has tempted him to buy one.

stories.title: Apple chip supplier TSMC approves $1 billion AI investment
stories.tldr: TSMC's board has approved investing up to $1 billion in OpenAI and Anthropic, buying as much as $500 million of shares in each. It ties Apple's main chipmaker closer to both AI labs.

stories.title: Google's Gemini assistant is rolling out on Apple CarPlay
stories.tldr: Google says a dedicated Gemini app for Apple CarPlay is rolling out globally in several languages from today, letting drivers talk to the assistant directly through CarPlay.

stories.title: How Godzilla Minus Zero dominated the box office
stories.tldr: GKIDS president Dave Jesteadt credits younger audiences and premium large formats like IMAX for Godzilla Minus Zero's record opening, part of a growing market for foreign-language films in US cinemas.

stories.title: Avengers: Endgame Encore sets Disney+ release date
stories.tldr: Disney+ will stream Avengers: Endgame: Encore from Friday 13 November, continuing the countdown to Avengers: Doomsday later this year.

stories.title: Attend, a marketplace linking filmmakers directly to theatre owners, launches
stories.tldr: The Fithian Group has launched Attend, billed as the first marketplace connecting filmmakers directly with theatre owners, debuting at the American Film Market.

stories.title: 'One in a Million' filmmaker on the ethical dilemma he faced
stories.tldr: Co-directors Itab Azzam and Jack MacInnes spent a decade documenting a young Syrian refugee in Germany, and discuss letting their subject find her own way through the story.

stories.title: Big Mitch quietly showed exactly why the Celtics signed him
stories.tldr: Buried beneath Tuesday's Jaylen Brown vs Jayson Tatum storylines was a quieter one: CelticsBlog explains why Boston's win over Philadelphia validated the decision to sign Big Mitch.

stories.title: Patriots' defence aims for redemption against another tough NFC North foe
stories.tldr: After conceding a season-high 45 points to the Packers last week, New England's defence faces the Lions on Sunday in Munich looking to put it right.

stories.title: George Russell credits Toto Wolff's loyalty for Mercedes' F1 title return
stories.tldr: George Russell says Toto Wolff's refusal to overhaul Mercedes during its difficult ground-effect years is a big reason the team has returned to the top of Formula 1.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli keeps F1 title promise with Italian flag hair
stories.tldr: Mercedes' new world champion Kimi Antonelli turned up at the team's Brackley factory with his hair dyed green, white and red, keeping a promise made before he won the title.

read.why: A practical case for redefining PM work norms rather than accepting 'the great flattening', and a good read for a product marketer on the same path, two years to the day since it published.
read.title: Product manager is an unfair role. So work unfairly.
read.subtitle: How to thrive in “the great flattening” by redefining work norms

listen.title: #426 How Obsession Built Christopher Nolan

listen.why: New this week: Senra talks to Robinhood's Vlad Tenev about building through chaos, from a Bulgarian childhood to surviving GameStop.
listen.title: Building Robinhood, Surviving GameStop & A $500 Million Phone Call | Vlad Tenev

listen.title: Nike

finally.title: 'I Made a Film in Excel, and I Don't Know Why'
finally.tldr: Animation director Maria Tomazou made a short animated film entirely in Microsoft Excel, a project with no real reason to exist beyond itself. It took ages, and she kept going anyway.
